programs.title: Live: IndyCar Racing
programs.desc: Six Oscar Mayer Wienermobiles race in the second annual Wienie 500 at Indianapolis Motor Speedway. Each car represents a different favorite hot dog - Corn Dog, Chi Dog, N.Y. Dog, Chili Dog, Seattle Dog and Slaw Dog, the reigning champion.

programs.title: Live: Indy 500 Pit Stop Challenge
programs.desc: Featuring head-to-head competition between pit crews, in which crews will simulate fuel hookup and change all four Firestone Firehawk tires to see who has the fastest time.

programs.title: The Jennifer Hudson Show
programs.desc: "Imperfect Women" cast members Kerry Washington, Elisabeth Moss and Kate Mara stop by to chat about their new series; Jennifer welcomes back Max Mudd from Charlotte, N.C., and surprises him with a special visit from popular librarian, children's literacy advocate and new host of the "Reading Rainbow" reboot Mychal Threets!

programs.title: 25 Words or Less Live
programs.desc: Teams compete to see who can guess secret words or phrases with a limited amount of clues and time; host Meredith Vieira.
